broker.name: Exness
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2008. Its site names 11 regulators, including FSA (Seychelles), CBCS, and FSC (BVI). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Unlimited.
broker.about: Exness says it has operated since 2008. The pages checked do not name one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard, Pro, Zero, and Raw Spread. Platforms named there include Exness Terminal, Exness Trade app, MetaTrader 4, and MetaTrader 5. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles), CBCS, FSC (BVI), FSC (Belize), FSC (Mauritius), CMA (Kenya), JSC, FSCA, CySEC, FCA, and CMA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Unlimited. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

FSC (Belize): Forexite Ltd., 9110312. FSC (Mauritius): Exness (MU) Ltd, GB20025294. CMA (Kenya): Exness (KE) Limited, 162. JSC: Exness Limited Jordan Ltd. FSCA: Exness ZA (PTY) Ltd, 51024. FSCA: Exness (SC) Ltd. CySEC: Exness (Cy) Ltd, 178/12. FCA: Exness (UK) Ltd, 730729. CMA.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage fetch worked. About page says Exness set out in 2008. The regulation FAQ names the UAE Capital Market Authority, but the licence cards on the same page do not give a UAE entity or licence number. Exness (Cy) Ltd and Exness (UK) Ltd are stated not to offer trading services to retail clients. Exness (MU) Ltd is stated not to currently provide retail services. Exness (SC) Ltd is also described as an FSCA Over-The-Counter Derivatives Provider, with no separate ODP number on the page. Jordan is described as regulated by the JSC, with company registration 51905 and no JSC licence number. CBCS country code is CW because the legal entity is registered in Curacao; the regulator also covers Sint Maarten.
